notes: Use 'หนาว' when describing the weather or the feeling of cold on your skin. If you are describing an object like a cold drink, use 'เย็น' (yen) instead.
When you feel cold, you can say 'ฉันรู้สึกหนาว' (I feel cold) or simply 'หนาว' (cold) as a state.
